x: In the Field Events our big Irish Guardsman, Pat Ridge, won both the Weight and Discus with very creditable efforts. Charlie Melchior " obliged " once more in the Javelin Throw, and E.

We have been glad to welcome a new member in the person [illegible] Pat Ridge of the Irish Guards, whose shot putting and discus throwing are first class and have been extremely useful in gaining us first places in several matches.
Hadley (Snr.), Bill Merryman, Sergeant Eilson, Len Herbert, Lawrie Jackson, Fred Bradman, Will Applebee, Dan Patience, Pat Ridge, Joe Daly (G.C.

In the coming season it is hoped to have the help of most of the "boys" who did so well last season, including genial Pat Ridge for the Shot and Discus, Charlie Melchior, evergreen George Powell, and L.

News of another well-known member of the Section also in the Middle East, in Bill Sutton, will be found on another page, and also an obituary notice of the late Pat Ridge, one of our Shot and Discus men.
He was a promising young runner, and gained a Club Standard Medal at One Mile in 1939, and would no doubt have shown further improvement had he been spared. "Pat" Ridge (Irish Guards).
In addition, there were PAT RIDGE and FRANK HANDLEY (both of the Irish Guards) killed in action, as were two other most promising athletes, K.N.
